provenance.runnerSource: Uncommitted combined-only runner update; archive freezes exact contents. Launcher checkout commit does not identify the runner.

fixture.inventoryScope: Relative file names, sizes and modification times, not content hashes.

measurement.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of all nine samples per implementation; three forks, not nine independent forks.
measurement.percentageFormula: (candidate mean / reference mean - 1) * 100; positive is slower.
measurement.comparisonLimitations: Descriptive cross-day comparisons using the same task JAR, fixture, settings and machine. A/B/C are not paired across days. Block comparisons use each new block against the prior overall mean, not the same-letter prior block. No equivalence, causal interaction or significance claim.

method.independent_selection: CPU candidate selection uses all resource/process samples without benchmark-score-based selection or exclusions.
method.background_screen: Every nonzero userspace COMMAND is reviewed. Candidate windows flag >=2 percent of one core, excluding Java and runner/sampler commands. Kernel processes are separate; their snapshot writeback is not called independent workload.
method.kernel_classification: Zero VIRT/RES/SHR plus recognized kernel command patterns (kworker, ksoftirqd, migration, jbd2, rcu, kcompactd and ZFS maintenance). Zero memory alone does not classify a process as kernel; Java and exiting cf-execd remain userspace.
method.time_mapping: Candidate CPU windows are previous top display UTC to active top display UTC, merged when consecutive. Exact logged snapshot start/finish pairs are assigned to one warmup and three measurements, checked against JMH iteration headers, post-return force timestamp ordering, and JSON metadata.
method.historical_exclusion: First top and vmstat reports excluded from interval summaries. First diskstats retained only as delta baseline.
limitations: COMMAND is not a full command line, so ownership cannot be fully established.
Five-second CPU windows and second-resolution top timestamps can indicate possible overlap, not performance impact or exact CPU timing.
Marker UTC can lag top display UTC by about a second; mapping uses display UTC.
No sample removals, causal attribution, or perfectly isolated machine claim.
Device aggregate counters do not attribute I/O to processes.
Logged Starting snapshot / Snapshot all finished intervals bracket internal work; JMH call time may include additional return/cleanup overhead. Per-interval duration deltas are preserved.

java_process_pattern.interpretation: Consistent with one JMH launcher plus one benchmark fork for each of 15 cells; process names alone do not prove ownership.

disk.interpretation: Large benchmark-device writes and kernel writeback are expected snapshot/drain activity, not evidence of another userspace workload. No io_ticks/wall-clock utilization claim is made.

validation_evidence.note: Successful teardown returns through validation after post-return force; separate success messages are not emitted for each validation. Three index checks inspect length/header and sampled values, plus metadata/store presence, not every record.
